entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. M.A. Khan, A.G.A. for the State.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant is in judicial custody in Fir No.282 of 2020, under Sections 376(3), 506 Ipc and under
Sections 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Transit
Camp, District Udham Singh Nagar.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, on 06.11.2020, when the victim, a young girl of 13 years, was sleeping all alone in her room, the applicant entered and established physical relations with her against her will.

He also threatened the victim that he had taken obscene photographs and in case, the victim reveals the incident to anyone he would make the photographs viral.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the statement of the victim is not reliable with regard to the injuries.
The incident is not supported by the medical evidence because on the one hand, according to the victim, she bled profusedly, whereas, there is no such material available on record.
5. Learned State Counsel would submit that the victim has supported the prosecution case during trial and the doctor has also supported the prosecution case.
6. It is the stage of bail.
Much of the discussion at this stage is not expected of.

To the extent of appreciating the controversy, the matter may be examined with the caveat that any observation,

1 made at this stage, shall have no bearing at any subsequent stage of the case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. The FIR is prompt.
The medical examination was done on the same day.
The victim has been consistent during investigation and during trial as to how the incident took place.
She has given statement that she bled profusedly.
In her examination during trial, the victim has supported the prosecution case.
8. Having considered the entirety of facts, this Court is of the view that it is not a case fit for bail.
Accordingly, the bail application deserves to be rejected.
9. The bail application is rejected.
